result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural framing centered on patients and public health rather than shareholders, employees, or governance. Uses absolute language such as Health for All and all people deserve healthy lives. Commitments are mostly stated firmly, though the trachoma goal is hedged as a focus with a 2020 target. Workforce, environment, and integrity topics are absent.
